name: waypoint-service-kit
description: waypoint-service-kit tooling: 10 wp-kit-* agents (common, messaging, testing and release builders plus read-only API-stability, security, observability and reliability reviewers for the shared NestJS packages, plus a .github maintainer), 11 /wp-* commands, 7 path-scoped rules, 12 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-service-kit checkout.
